integrity: The open primary full text was inspected at the WLBRL density, simulation parameter table, real-data sample-size description, Table 5 information criteria, Table 6 parameter-count note, and conclusion. The AIC/BIC comparison is a direct identity check against the source's printed quantities, and the standalone checker was replayed from its packaged path.
scientific_limitations: Corrected AIC and BIC values are conditional on the source's printed -2logL entries being the intended maximized deviances.
The AICc arithmetic uses the conventional small-sample correction only as an additional check; the central result uses only AIC and BIC.
Competing-model rankings are not recomputed because their likelihood and complexity accounting would also require consistent validation.
